items.title: Woven Key Fret DXF Lattice for Modern Door Panels
items.description: A tight grid of interlocking key-fret motifs repeats edge to edge, giving the panel a woven, basket-like texture. The dense, uniform structure suits contemporary railings and privacy screens that need strong coverage with an intricate look.

items.title: Intricate Moroccan Geometric Lattice Cutting File for Architecture
items.description: Enhance your interior decor collection with this captivating Moroccan geometric lattice pattern, utilizing interlocking diagonal lines and repeating traditional star-burst vectors. Fully prepared in production-ready DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this balanced template guarantees crisp edges and flawless results on CNC routers, fiber lasers, and waterjet machines for security window grills, cabinetry inserts, and custom dividers.

items.title: Blooming Daisy Lattice DXF Pattern for CNC Screens
items.description: Rows of six-petal daisies interlock with small diamond gaps between each flower, creating a soft, garden-inspired lattice. The rounded petal shapes soften the geometry of a typical partition screen without adding cutting complexity.
